NUTR 4600/6600.lateWork: Main discussion posts submitted late but before the discussion closes lose 1.5 points per day; nothing accepted after 11:59 PM EST on the follow-up post due date; late quizzes, exams and policy letter
NUTR 4600/6600.makeups: Final decisions on make-ups are at the instructor's discretion; due dates move only for an extenuating hardship verified through Student Care and Outreach.
other: Quizzes must be done on your own.
Graduate total is 650 points (500 plus 150 additional).
Incompletes only for serious illness or emergency when roughly under 25% of the course is left.
